output_type_note: Must be one of: susceptibility_class | risk_category | calibrated_probability. A score is shown as a probability only if output_type = calibrated_probability and calibration is documented.
known_limitations: No trained model has been supplied to the portal yet.
When a model is connected, document spatial/temporal validation so there is no leakage from future data.
integration_instructions: Write one GeoJSON per reporting window to data/predictions/<window_id>.geojson (e.g. 2026-27-W01.geojson) and fill in this card. See data/predictions/README.md.
